reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not the date in this morning's #north-team post, and told her I hadn't changed anything else.

As she asked, I didn't change anything in #north-team, files, calendar or mail. Her original #north-team post is still up and still shows the wrong date, because only she can edit it. Repeating the date in #north-random was fine: she had already posted it there herself, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure.
